title: A Ghost for the Asset
author: Cyrus Thackeray
blurb: Sebastian Yarrow, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
